knowledge_graph.title: COVID-19 vaccination in Italy
knowledge_graph.description: The COVID-19 vaccination campaign in Italy is a mass immunization campaign that was put in place by the Italian government in order to respond to the ongoing COVID-19 pandemic. It started on 27 December 2020, together with most countries in the European Union.
